reviewNotes: HOLD. Current Claro Chile material establishes an active prepaid product, mandatory subscriber identification, current recharge-validity/recovery tiers and a 180-day total balance-recovery window. The current self-activation flow asks for a valid Chilean identity card; a new-line foreign-passport path is not established. Current prepaid-specific overseas SMS/OTP behavior and foreign-card recharge execution also remain unresolved.

events.outcome: Current Claro Chile prepaid evidence establishes subscriber identification and a 180-day total recharge/recovery window, but current foreign-passport new-line activation, prepaid overseas SMS behavior and foreign-card recharge execution remain unresolved.

data.acquisitionSummary: Claro Chile continues to sell Prepago/Plan Simple SIMs through Claro and retail channels. The current activation flow uses *103#, an SMS link, both sides of a valid identity card and a selfie. A current starter-SIM price and a new-line foreign-passport activation path were not reliably established, so the old CLP4,990 acquisition figure is not carried forward.

keep.action: The current recharge portal lists CLP750-1,999 as the lowest tier: 7 active days plus 173 recovery days, for 180 days total. Higher recharge tiers also total 180 days through different active/recovery splits. This proves a balance recovery window, not a complete number-deactivation clock, so no annual number-retention cost is claimed.

data.chinaActivation: Current Claro self-activation is Chile-local and asks for a valid Chilean identity card plus selfie. China-first activation is not established.
data.kyc: Subscriber identification is mandatory under the current prepaid flow. The reviewed new-line flow asks for a current Chilean identity card; Claro service/recovery material can accept passport in some in-person cases, but that does not establish a foreign-passport new-SIM activation route.
data.payment: Claro has a current online recharge portal, but the reviewed material does not establish reliable foreign-bank-card execution. Treat payment from abroad as unresolved.
data.roamingSms: Claro’s current generic roaming surface confirms roaming service exists, but the reviewed material does not clearly establish current prepaid roaming/incoming-SMS terms for this route or mainland-China OTP behavior.
data.holdReason: Foreign-passport new-line activation, full number-deactivation lifecycle, prepaid overseas SMS/OTP behavior and foreign-card recharge execution remain unresolved.
data.tariffSummary: Current recharge tiers provide a 180-day total active/recovery balance window; subscriber identification is mandatory. Full number-retention lifecycle and foreign-user execution remain unresolved; HOLD.
guideSteps: Use only the current subscriber-identification flow; do not market Claro Chile prepago as no-KYC.
Treat the 180-day rule as balance validity/recovery, not automatically as number ownership duration.
Do not claim China OTP or foreign-card recharge reliability without current prepaid-specific evidence.
